story.title: Nigeria Forms Panel to Investigate Deaths of 37 Miners in Custody
story.summary: The Nigerian government has established a 10-member independent panel to investigate the deaths of 37 suspected illegal gold miners in a holding cell operated by a paramilitary civil defense force. Survivors have described their distressing experiences in detention, while protests erupted in Minna, leading to police deploying tear gas and imposing a curfew. Families of the deceased are demanding justice following the incident.

related_stories.title: Patrick Clancy Discusses Forgiveness and Grief After Mistrial
related_stories.summary: In his first interview since the mistrial of his ex-wife, Patrick Clancy spoke about the tragic loss of their three children. He expressed that he forgave her to avoid being consumed by anger and grief. Clancy shared details about the events leading up to the deaths of his children and how he has been coping with the aftermath.

related_stories.title: Three Arrested in Connection with Series of Killings of Women in South Africa
related_stories.summary: Two women and a man have been arrested in connection with one of several recent killings of women in South Africa, which has raised significant concern over violence against women in the country. The arrests occurred on the outskirts of Johannesburg, where multiple incidents have been reported in recent months.

related_stories.title: Charles Spencer Accuses King Charles of Gaslighting Over Diana Memoir
related_stories.summary: Charles Spencer, the brother of Princess Diana, has accused King Charles III of 'gaslighting' him regarding his recollections of events surrounding Diana's death. This accusation comes ahead of the release of Spencer's memoir, where he claims the King was 'giddily elated' shortly after Diana's passing. The controversy has sparked significant discussion in the UK as the memoir's publication approaches.
